# Skill Template
# Copy this file to create a new skill definition.
# File naming: <skill-name>.skill.md (kebab-case)

# Instructions:
# 1. Copy this file to .github/skills/<your-skill-name>.skill.md
# 2. Fill in the front matter (description, name)
# 3. Define capabilities, best practices, and when to use
# 4. Register the skill in .github/agents-config/registry.yaml
# 5. Assign the skill to relevant agents in the registry

---

```yaml
---
description: "<One-line description of what this skill enables>"
name: <Skill Display Name>
---
```
